name: Macro VIX-spike capitulation reversion — buy crypto into an equity fear extreme
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the CONTRARIAN mirror of macro-vix-calm-riskon-long, and distinct from fear-greed-contrarian which uses the CRYPTO-native sentiment index): a VIX spike marks a cross-asset panic where forced equity deleveraging spills into correlated crypto and overshoots to the downside. Once the fear extreme is in (VIX above a fitted panic floor) the marginal seller is exhausted and risk assets snap back as the volatility premium decays — a documented post-VIX-spike equity reversion (the 'buy the VIX spike' effect) transferred to crypto via its risk-asset beta. The signal is EXTERNAL (US equity options panic), so it fires on macro stress crypto's own sentiment may not yet show. Entry: VIX above a fitted panic floor AND price not in freefall (a trend floor = the knife guard, mirroring fear-greed-contrarian's structure). Exit: VIX crosses DOWN through a calm threshold (panic relieved, reversion played out) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if an unconditional dip-buy over the same sample matches the deflated Sharpe, the VIX extreme adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: VIX panics co-occur with crypto fear_greed lows; if substituting fear_greed does as well this is fear-greed-contrarian re-skinned and adds no orthogonal MACRO panic information. Disconfirmer 3 (cost): the bounce must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier0 macro feature, low-confidence until OOS.
